etl_logic: CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN internal_statistical_report.column_path = 'TỔNG CỘNG' THEN internal_statistical_report.cell_val END) AS INT) WHERE internal_statistical_report.src_stm_code = 'ISS_INTERNAL_STATISTICAL_REPORT' AND internal_statistical_report.rpt_code = 'TTLK01' AND internal_statistical_report.rpt_submission_stm_code = 'ICP' AND internal_statistical_report.submission_status_code IN ('SUBMITTED','LATE_SUBMITTED') AND LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('01/', internal_statistical_report.period_val), 'dd/MM/yyyy')) <= :etl_date GROUP BY internal_statistical_report.row_index, internal_statistical_report.period_val
source_attribute: Column Path / Cell Value / Source System Code / Report Code / Report Submission System Code / Submission Status Code / Row Index / Period Value
atomic_column: column_path / cell_val / src_stm_code / rpt_code / rpt_submission_stm_code / submission_status_code / row_index / period_val
